title: Intraday Portfolio Entry-Handoff State

selection_card.central_question: After exact strategy-period adjustment, do admitted entries differ materially according to whether they are the first flat-start entry of the server day, enter while another portfolio position remains active, or are the first same-day reentry after native closes return the whole portfolio to flat?
selection_card.why_now: The recent durable sequence is Program 4 Unit 052, Program 1 Unit 053, Program 5 Unit 054 and Program 7 Unit 055. Program 3 has not received a unit since Unit 047. Its exact-time signal-batch proposal was sparse and its native order-funnel proposal was structurally confounded, while this distinct causal event-order topology is broad across four periods and directly tests a real occupancy and release handoff.
selection_card.connection_bridge: Unit 052 found a lower stop association after a peer native close but no material return field, and the older exact-deadline capacity-release diagnostic found only three recoverable blocked proxies. Unit 056 moves to a different stage and height: it asks what happens to the next actually admitted entry after the entire portfolio becomes flat, while retaining incumbent-entry context as a bounded companion lens. This connects natural-exit order, slot release and entry sequencing without repeating peer-position management or blocked-candidate recovery.
selection_card.decision_if_true: A passing incumbent or post-native-flat state may retain one later entry-preserving occupancy or handoff-treatment question after a future whole-map comparison. It does not select a filter, delay, suppression, lot, slot, order, exit, EA or Live action now.
selection_card.decision_if_false: Do not spend a new MQL or real-tick matrix on intraday portfolio handoff treatment; preserve first-come entry order and rotate to a different program or height.
selection_card.not_adjacent_or_random: The unit is not an adjacent Unit 052 exit rule, not a retry of Unit 017 SOLO versus CROWDED, and not a novelty jump. It uses a complete same-day handoff partition, a different primary program and a broad already-consumed four-period evidence boundary. The new research logger is not used merely because it was just built.
automatic_followups_forbidden: incumbent identity, count, direction or symbol split
same-second close and birth ordering rescue
strategy, period, weekday or session subgroup
lot, slot, priority, delay, suppression or exit implementation

macro_rotation.program_1: Unit 053 is recent and the prior signal-transition state already failed; no adjacent signal or US500 structure work is selected.
macro_rotation.program_2: Official event and external-market questions require a new causal data role; the ready tracked contexts have not shown material effects and no fresh source boundary currently outranks this handoff topology.
macro_rotation.program_3: Selected because the exact four-period event order makes one dense meso-level entry-handoff bundle possible after two different Program 3 proposals were rejected as sparse or confounded.
macro_rotation.program_4: Unit 052 is recent. This unit does not manage the held target after peer exit; it observes a later new entry only after a complete portfolio-state transition.
macro_rotation.program_5: Units 050 and 054 are recent and did not retain a book-allocation or common-loss response. Capital, lot and slot treatment remain closed.
macro_rotation.program_7: Unit 055 just closed. Another meta census would not improve economic discrimination more than the ready entry-handoff question.
macro_rotation.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all three research heights. Do not open an adjacent handoff, crowding, flat-release or timing treatment automatically.

variants.treatment: At the exact admitted-birth timestamp, at least one portfolio lifecycle is already active before the whole birth batch is added.
variants.comparator: DAY_FIRST_FROM_FLAT inside the same strategy and fresh period.
variants.excluded_from_variant: RC4 has only 15 incumbent entries and is context-only for this comparison.

variants.treatment: A prior same-server-day birth exists, a strictly earlier batch of native CLOSE events returned the complete active portfolio to zero, and no lifecycle is active before this birth batch.
variants.comparator: DAY_FIRST_FROM_FLAT inside the same strategy and fresh period.
variants.excluded_from_variant: RC16 has one observation and RC4 has zero; both are context-only for this comparison.

context_only_roles.reason: No P1 observations and insufficient broad density.
Second-resolution ordering cannot establish a strict close-before-new-birth handoff.

distinction_from_closed_work.entry_time_crowding_value: The earlier field compared all SOLO and CROWDED entries only by active count. Unit 056 uses a complete intraday sequence topology and separates a fresh day start from a later reentry after the whole portfolio naturally returns flat. Incumbent entry is one bounded companion role, with no identity, count or direction rescue.
distinction_from_closed_work.risk_capacity_release_window: That diagnostic asked whether a blocked candidate regained capacity before its own fixed deadline and found only three proxies. Unit 056 uses only actually admitted later entries and no blocked or counterfactual candidate.
distinction_from_closed_work.held_position_first_peer_exit_state: Unit 052 assigned a state to a target that remained held after another component exited. Unit 056 waits until the complete portfolio is flat and assigns state to the next newly admitted lifecycle; it uses no peer-target management outcome.
distinction_from_closed_work.same_strategy_outcome_memory: Unit 023 used the sign of the previous same-strategy outcome. Unit 056 uses portfolio event order, occupancy and native-versus-stop close class only; no prior profit or loss sign enters the role.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only raw-file identity, exact event type, exact component, server timestamp, within-timestamp batch membership and active-lifecycle topology informed classification. Economic close fields were not cast, aggregated, grouped by role or inspected for an effect.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, source path and source line, while assigning handoff roles to the complete exact-timestamp batch before adding any birth in that batch.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores one positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with the active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the exact active component lifecycle; value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD and EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop-loss exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.day_reset: At each new server date, reset same-day birth and flat-handoff memory while preserving any genuinely active carried lifecycle.
fixed_reconstruction.flat_transition: A close batch creates a flat handoff only when at least one lifecycle was active before the batch and none remains after all closes in that exact timestamp. Any EXTERNAL_CLOSE makes the batch stop-flat; otherwise it is native-flat.
fixed_reconstruction.same_time_exclusion: Any birth sharing an exact server timestamp with at least one close is SAME_TIME_CLOSE_BIRTH and cannot be assigned a strict handoff role.
fixed_reconstruction.batch_birth_assignment: All births sharing one exact timestamp receive the same pre-batch role before any of those births is added to active state.
fixed_reconstruction.benchmark: For each eligible variant strategy x period cell, compute DAY_FIRST_FROM_FLAT mean stressed R and stop rate.
fixed_reconstruction.variant_residual: For each treatment lifecycle subtract its exact same-strategy-period DAY_FIRST_FROM_FLAT benchmark stressed R and stop rate.

fixed_metrics.role_report: For all five topology roles report n, 2x stressed net, mean stressed R, stop rate and positive rate by pooled, period and strategy views.
fixed_metrics.variant_report: For each eligible variant report equal-lifecycle pooled mean stressed-R residual and stop residual, four period residual means, eligible-strategy residual means and contribution shares.
fixed_metrics.period_contribution_share: Absolute period residual-sum divided by the sum of absolute residual-sums across four periods.
fixed_metrics.strategy_contribution_share: Absolute eligible-strategy residual-sum divided by the sum of absolute residual-sums across eligible strategies.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six event files retain their exact byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
Retain 16,477 data rows with zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594, 407.0477 USD 2x stressed net and 206 stop exits.
Finish every period with zero active lifecycle and zero pending Passive order, with zero pairing, overlap, risk, close, batch-order or classification fault.
Reproduce every frozen total, period, strategy and eligible-variant topology count.
Reconstruct every required finite DAY_FIRST_FROM_FLAT strategy-period benchmark cell.

density: Treatment and comparator reproduce their exact frozen pooled, period, strategy and minimum strategy-period counts.
Treatment has at least 30 lifecycles in every period and at least 15 in every eligible strategy.
Every eligible treatment strategy-period cell has at least three lifecycles and every comparator cell at least four.
information: Absolute pooled mean stressed-R residual is at least 0.10R.
Absolute pooled mean stop residual is at least 0.05.
The pooled channels are economically concordant: negative R requires positive stop residual, while positive R requires negative stop residual.
Stressed-R residual shares the pooled sign in at least three of four periods and at least four of five eligible strategies for ENTRY_WITH_INCUMBENT or three of four for POST_NATIVE_FLAT_REENTRY.
Stop residual shares the pooled sign under the same period and eligible-strategy breadth requirements.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one eligible strategy more than 50% of the absolute stressed-R residual numerator.
fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. Zero is never counted as a sign.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: This is consumed-data association and selects no action. A passing role is only a parked seed for a later whole-map comparison.
fixed_bundle_gate.selection_if_exactly_one: Retain only the passing role as one later entry-preserving question.
fixed_bundle_gate.selection_if_both: Record both states but retain no automatic successor; the next whole-map comparison decides whether either outranks other programs.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before calculating any role-conditioned stressed R, stop association, residual, gate or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six immutable event files using the six exact component identities.
Do not alter role assignment, eligible strategies, comparator, centering, metrics, density or information gates.
Do not add incumbent identity/count/direction, time-since-flat, stop-flat, same-second ordering, strategy, period, weekday, session or symbol rescue.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, inspect Program 6, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and return to whole-map comparison without adjacent Program 3 handoff or timing work.
